citations.quote: ZINPLAVA™ is indicated to reduce recurrence of *Clostridoides difficile* infection (CDI) in adults and pediatric patients 1 year of age and older who are receiving antibacterial drug treatment for CDI and are at a high risk for CDI recurrence.

ZINPLAVA is not indicated for the treatment of CDI. ZINPLAVA is not an antibacterial drug. ZINPLAVA should only be used in conjunction with antibacterial drug treatment of CDI. [See Dosage and Administration (2.1).]

target_moa.text: Bezlotoxumab is a human monoclonal IgG1 antibody that binds to C. difficile toxin B and neutralizes its effects, inhibiting binding of toxin B and preventing its effects on mammalian cells; it does not bind toxin A.

citations.quote: ZINPLAVA (bezlotomumab) is a human monoclonal antibody that binds to *C. difficile* toxin B and neutralizes its effects [see *Microbiology (12.4)*].

Bezlotomumab is a human monoclonal antibody that binds *C. difficile* toxin B with an equilibrium dissociation constant (K_d) of <1 \times 10^{-9}M. Bezlotomumab inhibits the binding of toxin B and prevents its effects on mammalian cells. Bezlotomumab does not bind to *C. difficile* toxin A.
Bezlotomumab is a human monoclonal antibody that binds to *C. difficile* toxin B and neutralizes its effects. Bezlotomumab is an IgG1 immunoglobulin with an approximate molecular weight of 148.2 kDa.
